content.short: Tokenize real-world assets, fractionalize ownership, and participate in cross-border fundraising made simple, transparent, and compliant.
content.description: LEND7 enables asset-backed fundraising using blockchain technology. Development Project kicks off. The developer unlocks milestone-based payments aligned with the project plan, while LEND7 carefully reviews and validates all submitted documents to ensure accuracy and compliance. All projects in LEND7 platform will be secured by mortgage of real estate, and the mortgaged property must be insured by Developer providing an insurance agreement to LEND7.
